what: Design Step 0 always passes --skip-repo-check so REPO is never emitted
scenario_or_breakage: Plan snippet passes --repo "$REPO" to tracking-issue-write, design-log-publish, and gh pr merge while REPO is typically unset; gh calls may fail or target the wrong repo
suggested_fix: Omit --repo when empty and rely on gh cwd default like plan-block-write resolve_repo; or stop skipping repo derivation for design; or extend Step 0 to parse emit_kv REPO when present

what: Step 0 only requires parsing SESSION_TMPDIR and reviewer flags not SESSION_ID
scenario_or_breakage: Planned publish uses "$SESSION_ID" but the skill never binds it unless the orchestrator infers it; empty run-id hits planned fail-fast or wrong log directory
suggested_fix: Parse SESSION_ID from session-setup output in Step 0 or read DESIGN_TMPDIR/session-id in Step 5 and document which

what: Plan claims default-branch guard mirrors larch-log commit as main-only
scenario_or_breakage: larch-log uses current_branch_is_default (main master or origin/HEAD); a repo whose default is develop could commit design logs on develop while thinking they are safe
suggested_fix: Reuse the same probe as larch-log (factor shared helper or call equivalent git checks) not a main-only string compare

what: Hand-written manifest.json with a slim field set diverges from larch-log init manifest

suggested_fix: Either generate a schema-identical stub via larch-log init then manifest update or document design manifests as a distinct sub-schema and audit tools accordingly
